videos.script: A referral is when somebody who already works at a company passes your name to the people hiring. {{what}} It does not get you the job. It gets your CV read by a person, which is the step most applications never reach. {{read}} Most people starting out think they know nobody, and feel that asking is begging. Both are usually wrong. {{wrong}} This lesson explains why a referral works, finds the people you already know, and writes the message that asks without embarrassing either of you.
